newsitem.title: USA: LS Capital's Papone's Palace files Ch. 11.
newsitem.headline: LS Capital's Papone's Palace files Ch. 11.

text.p: Papone's Palace LLC said Wednesday that it has filed to reorganize under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code.
Papone's Palace is 75.5 percent owned by Papone's Palace Acquistion Corp, a wholly-owned subsidiary of LS Capital Corp.
Papone's said the filing was necessary because the minority holder filed a lawsuit to block an agreement with a mortgage holder on restructuring a $1.05 million mortgage.
